# Re-rank proposal 4 (mid-card new defect: card 214, corrective for F-056, during card 213)

- Led by: product manager seat, fresh context. Claude seat because probes at 08:03 UTC show Codex, Copilot, Grok and agy without usable quota (.mob/records/probes/2026-10-30.jsonl).
- Before list (Ready): 213 (in progress; Done check 1 green, Done check 2 green in progress by the dev seat), 209, 210, 208, 211, 212, 206, 207.
- Proposed after list:
  1. 214 (F-056 corrective: the generated API binds its own port; the ci test job for fb13e3d is red, run 41020033271, and a red CI and an open FAIL both stop the line)
  2. 213 (checker rejects an incomplete objection window; pauses after its current green commit and resumes when 214 is Done)
  3. 209 (MD-001)
  4. 210 (MD-003)
  5. 208 (MD-002, F-008)
  6. 211 (MD-010, records only, may run in parallel)
  7. 212 (re-rank for every mob; depends on 208)
  8. 206 (F-008, findings mirror)
  9. 207 (F-008 history rules; depends on 206)
- Rationale (one line): a red CI on main and an open FAIL stop the line, and "passed on retry" does not close F-056, so the root-cause fix for the flaky port bind goes first, 213 resumes straight after, and everything else keeps its order.

## What changed and why
- 214 is new and enters at position 1. It is the corrective card the auditor asked to rank high and root-cause. Until it is Done with git evidence, the line is stopped and every other card inherits the flake: any CI run, including 213's own, can go red for a reason unrelated to its change.
- 213 moves from 1 to 2. I accept the facilitator's suggestion with conditions: the dev seat finishes the commit it already has green (Done check 2), pushes it, and then stops; it does not start Done check 3 until 214 is Done. Finishing the current commit avoids losing work in flight and costs minutes; stopping there avoids stacking more unproven work on a main that cannot show a trustworthy green.
- Nothing else moves. 209, 210, 208, 211, 212, 206, 207 keep their relative order and their dependencies.

## Conditions (proposed, to be adopted and re-polled inside the window)
1. 214 does not start until it is Ready by the normal rule: its task force is declared by objection window with every declared role polled (F-054), and QA has written the ZOMBIES for its three Done checks.
2. The pause on 213 starts when 213's current commit is pushed, not before. If that commit's CI goes red on the same port-bind error, it is recorded against F-056 and is not re-run to green; the card does not count as passing on a retry.
3. 214 Done check 1 (root cause shown red) comes first and is committed red before the fix, so the cause is proved and not assumed. No retry-on-bind-failure and no change to xUnit parallelism (both are out of scope on the card).
4. 214 closes F-056 only with git evidence: the commit that removes FreeLoopbackPort and a green full acceptance suite in CI on the card's last commit. A single green re-run of fb13e3d does not close it.
5. F-054 and F-055 are practice corrections, not cards; they stay as practice changes and are not ranked here.

## Evidence considered
- Findings: audit 24 F-056 (open FAIL, CI test job for fb13e3d failed on "Failed to bind to address http://127.0.0.1:34727: address already in use" in Phrase.Acceptance.Tests.UsableV1.Bar5_the_app_runs_and_live_http_matches_the_specs); F-054 and F-055 practice corrections; MD-001, MD-002, MD-003, MD-010 still open as before.
- Card 214 (gh issue view 214): Draft, Shape Contract, bug, no dependencies, three Done checks; facilitator triage names GeneratedApi.FreeLoopbackPort (GeneratedApi.cs:230) choosing then releasing a port, with at least six test classes starting APIs in parallel; second hazard that WaitUntilListeningAsync can accept a foreign process on the port. Triage is unconfirmed until check 1 shows it red.
- Card 213 progress: Done check 1 green, Done check 2 green in progress; the dev seat can finish the current commit cheaply.
- Workflow rule: a red CI stops the line; any open FAIL stops the line until closed with git evidence.
- Model availability: only Claude usable (probes 08:03 UTC). The overdue-audit blocker is unchanged by this re-rank.

## Neither a one-way door nor a standing-rule change
The Rank field is edited in git and can be reversed by the next re-rank. It changes no agreement, D-record, checker or published claim, and no data. It applies the existing stop-the-line rules and D148 as amended by D153 (loop-boundary re-rank or mid-card new defect is a listed routine decision). The conditions above apply to this card pair only and set no standing rule.

## Window rule
Each declared role seat answers in its own fresh context with either "no objection" or ONE fixed condition. A condition that is simply adopted and re-polled stays in the window; an unsettled objection goes to a full Decider.
